about: The numbers AB30 published, one entry per claim, each with where it appears and how derive.py computes it. check.py compares derive.py's results.json with these values; exact equality after the rounding named in the rule.

R1.points.all.published_in: REPORT.md, Results round 1, points table: all thirty 27 / 26

R1.points.proof_audit.published_in: REPORT.md, Results round 1, points table: proof audits 17 / 17

R1.points.house_results.published_in: REPORT.md, Results round 1, points table: house results 10 / 9

R1.points_from_item_rows.all.published_in: the same table, summed from the item rows rather than the family totals
R1.points_from_item_rows.all.rule: sum of on_pts and off_pts over round1/RESULT_final.json items

R1.points_from_item_rows.proof_audit.published_in: the same table, from the item rows

R1.points_from_item_rows.house_results.published_in: the same table, from the item rows

R1.cost.on.published_in: REPORT.md, Results round 1, cost table: total $61.26, median per run $1.68 (brain on)
R1.cost.on.rule: counted rows of round1/results.jsonl, arm on: sum and median of cost_usd_list, rounded to cents

R1.cost.off.published_in: REPORT.md, Results round 1, cost table: total $40.48, median per run $0.77 (brain off)

R2.cost_total.on.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 2: $17.05 for the brain as it runs
R2.cost_total.on.rule: counted rows of round2/results.jsonl, arm on: sum of cost_usd_list, rounded to cents

R3.cost.on.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 3 table: cost $30.88, median $1.37 (brain on)
R3.cost.on.rule: counted rows of round3/results.jsonl, arm on

R3.cost.off.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 3 table: cost $15.66, median $0.56 (brain off)
R3.cost.off.rule: counted rows of round3/results.jsonl, arm off

R4.points.graded_in_both_arms.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 4: the 12 items answered in both arms, all full
R4.points.graded_in_both_arms.rule: round4/REPORT_r4_final.json rows: sum of pts per arm

R4.median_item_cost.on_over_off.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 4: a median 1.81 times the control
R4.median_item_cost.on_over_off.rule: median over round4/REPORT_r4_final.json rows of on.cost / off.cost, rounded to 3 places

R4.totals_with_timeout_items.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 4: the round ends 13 against 13 of 14 items
R4.totals_with_timeout_items.rule: graded points plus items one arm timed out on, scored from timeout_items_grades.jsonl (both extra grades full); a timeout scores 0

R5A.median_item_cost.on_over_off.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 5a cost paragraph (on against off)
R5A.median_item_cost.on_over_off.rule: median over round5a/REPORT_r5a_final.json rows of on.cost / off.cost, rounded to 3 places

R5A.median_item_cost.on_over_onlegacy.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 5a: on against onlegacy 0.92 at the median
R5A.median_item_cost.on_over_onlegacy.rule: median of on.cost / onlegacy.cost, rounded to 2 places

R5A.totals_with_timeout_items.published_in: REPORT.md, Round 5a: on 7, off 6, onlegacy 6 of 8

STATUS.pairs_done.rule: the number of round-1 items with a result; check.py also reads ../STATUS.json and requires it to say the same
